plugins.name: azure-devops
plugins.description: Operate Azure DevOps through the Azure CLI's azure-devops extension (projects, repos, pull requests, pipelines, boards, wikis, artifacts). Strict preflight gate: reports a missing az CLI, missing azure-devops extension, or missing authentication and stops - never logs in or installs anything, and exposes no non-DevOps Azure features.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过 Azure CLI 的 azure-devops 扩展操作 Azure DevOps（项目、Git 仓库、PR、流水线、工作项、Wiki、制品）。内置严格预检：缺少 az CLI、缺少 azure-devops 扩展或未认证时输出提示并停止——本插件不负责登录、不负责安装扩展，也不暴露任何非 DevOps 的 Azure 功能。
